title: RevisionApp content manifest
description: The index the app downloads first. One entry per content pack.

schemaVersion.description: Wire format version. The app refuses anything newer than it understands.

id.description: Pack id. Becomes the builtin:<pack-id>:... id namespace in the app.

version.description: Bumped whenever the pack changes; the app diffs this before downloading.

path.description: Directory holding pack.json and cards/, relative to the branch root.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of pack.json followed by every card file, each terminated by a newline, in sorted filename order.

cardCount.description: Total cards across every card file; the app rejects a pack that delivers a different number.
